title: Ice Knight of the Red Sky
description: A humanoid warrior with a metallic horse head helmet stands in the foreground, glowing blue eyes visible through the visor. He wears ornate silver armor under a dark blue and red cape, holds a large double-bladed axe, and is surrounded by floating ice shards against a dramatic fiery red and orange sky with jagged crystalline mountains.
